newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5683/5700 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5683/5700 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5683.00/5700.00 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Thursday.
The official rate for Friday will be 5691.50.
On Wednesday the bid/offer rates were 5680.00/5698.00, with the official dollar rate 5689.00 from Thursday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
